ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with sparse high-intensity (white) features; white pixels occupy less than 10% of the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear streaks are mapped vertically and diagonally across the central surfaces. Small white circular pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; central depression angle estimated at approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude varies with significant jagged peaks on the upper medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the base transitioning to an upward sweep terminating in sharpened lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters localized heavily on the far left and right fluke tips; scattered white circular points present across the lower medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, non-parallel white linear tracks (rake marks) cutting through the dark background pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white calcified-looking material (barnacle clusters) protruding from the lateral tips and margins of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical white encrustation density with a larger, more prominent cluster on the left fluke tip compared to the right.
